title: a16z Podcast: Dell + EMC -- Why the Python Just Ate the Cow

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: We just witnessed the largest acquisition in tech history, and before Dell made it happen.
reader_summary.overview: We just witnessed the largest acquisition in tech history, and before Dell made it happen, it would have been hard to imagine. Not so much that the two companies would come together, but that the much smaller Dell would be buying its larger peer EMC. If he imagined anyone doing the acquisition it would have been EMC, says a16z’s Peter Levine.

key_points.text: If he imagined anyone doing the acquisition it would have been EMC, says a16z’s Peter Levine.
“EMC could only do this deal because they had activists.” Levine is joined on this segment of the a16z podcast by Actifio Founder and CEO Ash Ashutosh.
What were the technological forces that brought these two companies together.
